::: {.services-lead}
I build custom statistical models that help you make better business decisions — especially around pricing, demand, and cause and effect. These are the areas I work in most. Every engagement is shaped around your data, your constraints, and the decision you're actually trying to make.
:::

## What I can help with

::: {.service-grid}

::: {.service-card}
<span class="service-icon"><i class="bi bi-tags"></i></span>
<h3>Price Elasticity &amp; Optimization</h3>

Estimate how demand responds to price, and find the prices that maximize revenue or margin — even when there's little room to experiment.
:::

::: {.service-card}
<span class="service-icon"><i class="bi bi-graph-up-arrow"></i></span>
<h3>Demand Modeling &amp; Forecasting</h3>

Understand what drives demand and forecast it at the granularity you need for planning, inventory, and pricing decisions.
:::

::: {.service-card}
<span class="service-icon"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i></span>
<h3>Causal Inference &amp; Experimentation</h3>

Design and analyze A/B tests, or measure the real impact of a change from observational data when a clean experiment isn't possible.
:::

::: {.service-card}
<span class="service-icon"><i class="bi bi-sliders"></i></span>
<h3>Bayesian &amp; Custom Modeling</h3>

Build bespoke models around the structure of your problem, using Bayesian methods that make the most of sparse or messy data.
:::

:::

## What working together looks like

::: {.process-grid}

::: {.process-step}
<span class="process-number">1</span>
<h3>Understand</h3>

I start with your business context, your data, and the decision you actually need to make — before touching a model.
:::

::: {.process-step}
<span class="process-number">2</span>
<h3>Model</h3>

I build an interpretable model designed around the structure of your problem — not an off-the-shelf black box.
:::

::: {.process-step}
<span class="process-number">3</span>
<h3>Deliver</h3>

You get a working solution — code, forecasts, or a tool — with clear explanations for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
:::

:::

## Ways to work together

<ul class="engagement-list">
<li><strong>Project-based</strong> — a defined piece of work with clear deliverables, from a one-off pricing study to a full forecasting pipeline.</li>
<li><strong>Embedded or via agency</strong> — working alongside your team, or through an agency, as an extra pair of hands on a modeling problem.</li>
<li><strong>Advisory</strong> — reviewing existing models and analyses, sanity-checking assumptions, and advising on methodology and next steps.</li>
</ul>

::: {.services-cta}
Not sure which fits? [Get in touch](/contact.qmd) and tell me about your problem — I'll give you an honest view of whether and how I can help.
:::
